# accumulator.save_state { #healpyxel.accumulator.save_state }

```python
accumulator.save_state(
    state,
    output_path,
    meta,
    processing_metadata=None,
    input_path=None,
    on_duplicate='error',
)
```

Serialize accumulated state to Parquet with metadata.

Converts the state dict to a DataFrame via :func:`state_to_dataframe`,
then writes it to Parquet with an Arrow schema that embeds HEALPix
metadata. Also writes a companion ``.meta.json`` sidecar with full
processing history.

Includes idempotency checks via input fingerprinting (SHA-256 of path
+ size + mtime) to prevent accidental double-accumulation of the
same batch.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                | Type                         | Description                                                                                                  | Default    |
|---------------------|------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| state               | dict\[int, CellAccumulator\] | Accumulator state from :func:`accumulate_batch`.                                                             | _required_ |
| output_path         | Path                         | Path to write the parquet state file.                                                                        | _required_ |
| meta                | HEALPyxelxMetadata           | HEALPix metadata instance (nside, mode, order, etc.).                                                        | _required_ |
| processing_metadata | dict or None                 | Optional batch info dict with keys like ``batch_id``, ``columns``, ``n_cells``, ``total_observations``, etc. | `None`     |
| input_path          | Path or None                 | Path to input data file. Used for fingerprint tracking to detect duplicate accumulation.                     | `None`     |
| on_duplicate        | str                          | Action if input was already processed: ``'error'`` (raise) or ``'skip'`` (silently record).                  | `'error'`  |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                                                     |
|--------|------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | ValueError | If ``input_path`` already in ``processed_inputs`` and ``on_duplicate='error'``. |
